name: Turbinado Sugar
siboNotes: Pure sucrose is generally well-tolerated in SIBO as it's absorbed in the small intestine before reaching problematic bacterial populations.
preparationTips: Use in baking as 1:1 replacement for white sugar
Dissolves well in hot beverages and warm liquids
Has a subtle molasses flavor that complements coffee and tea
Store in airtight container to prevent hardening
nutritionalHighlights: Contains trace minerals from minimal processing
Similar caloric content to white sugar (4 calories per gram)
